name: manual_bf09da
claim: Fresh isolated GitHub CLI device authorization plus read-back of an allowlisted unedited digest-bound comment is procedural human-approval evidence for a qualification or model-launch decision: it proves the local ceremony and account-owned confirmation, not an independently attested device code or MFA event. Agents may initiate or verify the flow but never perform the human login or post. The one-time code is never stored; the marker is single-use and binds exact inputs so a failed post requires a fresh login.

decisions.notes: Corrected full-scope formulation preserves the established isolated-login, exact-comment, one-time-marker, and agent-versus-human boundary while removing the unsupported MFA/device-code attestation claim.

rationale: Corrected full-scope formulation preserves the established isolated-login, exact-comment, one-time-marker, and agent-versus-human boundary while removing the unsupported MFA/device-code attestation claim.
